title: Bug Resolution Clustering
scenario: Find dates where more than 5 bugs were resolved within the same 1-hour window.
tableSchema: status_history (bug_id INT, status VARCHAR, changed_at TIMESTAMP)
hint: Use window function with range frame.
correctQuery: SELECT changed_at FROM (SELECT changed_at, COUNT(*) OVER(ORDER BY changed_at RANGE BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND INTERVAL '1 hour' FOLLOWING) as bug_burst FROM status_history WHERE status = 'Resolved') t WHERE bug_burst > 5;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE status_history (bug_id INT, status VARCHAR, changed_at TIMESTAMP);
